analysis: The gated transition trial completed successfully but reduced host validation macro HR@10 from the reference 0.6200 to 0.5975, a decline of 0.0225. Category HR@10 fell in all four datasets: Movies_and_TV 0.665 versus 0.675; Industrial_and_Scientific 0.585 versus 0.600; Electronics 0.445 versus 0.495; CDs_and_Vinyl 0.695 versus 0.710. Electronics showed the largest decline, at 0.050. These results do not support retaining this transition residual under the tested configuration. They do not establish why it regressed: member metrics and training diagnostics are not included in the supplied host result. The trial consumed 479.69 allocated GPU-seconds.
code_summary: Retained separate per-category MultVAE and SASRec models with equal-weight mean-rank fusion and stable candidate tie ordering. Added SASRec source-item embeddings and a sigmoid scalar gate: h = features + sigmoid(Linear(features)) * source_emb(current_item), scoring against the existing shared item embeddings. Source embeddings used normal initialization with standard deviation 0.02 and a zero padding row; gate weights started at zero with bias -2. Training retained uniform positive-plus-16-negative cross-entropy and independent validation checkpoint selection. Strict checkpoint reconstruction and the generated predictor included the transition branch. Added checks for residual scoring, padding, gradients, causality, reload, and predictor agreement. Preserved all four dataset routes, seed-42 training, fixed validation candidates, trial-local artifacts, and single-GPU execution.
